newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-INSIGHT-Australia bonds on offshore surveillance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-INSIGHT-Australia bonds on offshore surveillance.

text.p: *The March Australian 10-year bond futures contract will start Monday's session testing psychological support at 92.500 after U.S. Treasuries weakened on Friday.
*Slow session expected ahead of the Christmas holiday with little to guide the market other than events overseas.
The March Australian 10-year bond futures contract will start Monday's session testing psychological support at 92.500 after U.S. Treasuries weakened on Friday.
The local contract ended afterhours SYCOM trading at 92.510 compared with an open outcry close of 92.530 and was testing the lower limits of Friday's tight dayside range.

Profit-taking and disappointment that the minutes from the November Federal Open Market Committee meeting revealed that officials voted to keep a tighter bias saw U.S. bonds give up some of the strong gains made on Thursday.
A slow session is expected locally ahead of the Christmas holiday and with little to guide the market other than events overseas, traders said.
Support is penciled in at between 92.450 and 92.470 on the 10-year contract if 92.500 caves in, while moves to the upside are expected to find resistance at 92.550 to 92.580.

However, the contract needs to overcome 92.650 before the technical outlook turns more positive, although this would appear an unlikely move in the short-term given the anticipated thin conditions and the easier tone of the U.S.
